[B1] < CloudX | DeviceX : ('trusts' : (UserX , Rest) , 'key' : Key , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'requestKey' CloudX
=> < CloudX | DeviceX : ('trusts' : (UserX , Rest) , 'key' : Key , ...) , ... > $ CloudX 'sendKey' UserX | Key if Key =/= nils .
[B1] < UserX | 'key' : nils , ... > $ CloudX 'sendKey' UserX | Key
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > .
[B2] < CloudX | DeviceX : ('trusts' : (UserX , Rest) , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'delegateAccess' CloudX | (DeviceX ; UserY)
=> < CloudX | DeviceX : ('trusts' : (UserX , UserY , Rest) , ...) , ... > .
[B3] < CloudX | DeviceX : ('trusts' : (UserX , UserY , Rest) , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'revokeAccess' CloudX | (DeviceX ; UserY)
=> < CloudX | DeviceX : ('trusts' : (UserX , Rest) , ...) , ... > .
[B4] < cloudSmartThing | DeviceX : ('key' : Key , 'trusts' : Trusted , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'provideKey' cloudSmartThing | (DeviceX ; Key)
=> < cloudSmartThing | DeviceX : ('key' : Key , 'trusts' : (UserX , Trusted) , ...) , ... > .
[B5] < DeviceX | ... > $ UserX 'turnOn' DeviceX
=> < DeviceX | ... > .
[B6] < CloudX | DeviceX : ('on' : false , 'trusts' : (P , Rest) , ...) , ... > $ P 'turnOn' DeviceX
=> < CloudX | DeviceX : ('on' : true , 'trusts' : (P , Rest) , ...) , ... > $ CloudX 'turnOn' DeviceX .
[B7] < cloudSmartThing | DeviceX : ('boundTo' : B , ...) , ... > $ cloudSmartThing 'turnOn' DeviceX
=> < cloudSmartThing | DeviceX : ('boundTo' : B , ...) , ... > $ cloudSmartThing 'turnOn' B .
[B8] < deviceLock | 'trusts' : (P , Rest) , 'on' : false , ... > $ P 'turnOn' deviceLock
=> < deviceLock | 'trusts' : (P , Rest) , 'on' : true , ... > .

[B3] < UserX | ... > < UserY | ... > < CloudX | ... > < DeviceX | ... > => ev3(UserX, CloudX, DeviceX, UserY) .
[B4] < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < DeviceX | ... > => ev4(UserX, DeviceX, Key) .
[B5] < UserX | ... > < DeviceX | ... > => ev5(UserX, DeviceX) .
